remarks: One of a kind apartment.... Come see this enchanting treehouse in the pulse of vibrant downtown Stamford! This 2nd floor corner apartment is bright, airy + lined with windows giving you a bird's-eye view onto Stamford's most exciting urban corner. Recently renovated with an open designer kitchen + new appliances, you'll also enjoy high 9' ceilings, hardwood floors in the living area, fresh new paint, carpeting and a/c. Most importantly - Location, location, location - walk to UCONN, Theaters, popular restaurants, shops, bars, pubs, train station and the Ferguson Library. Parking is available across the street in the Bedford St. garage (about 75.00 monthly), heat and hot water are included in the rent. Building entry & elevator soon to be beautifully renovated.
